name: Searing Gorge
summary: In Searing Gorge, the Dark Iron clan works a land once joined to the green Redridge Mountains. Ragnaros the Firelord scorched it when he was summoned over two centuries ago. Now the Thorium Brotherhood watches the clan's slave mines in the Cauldron.

sections.title: A Scorched Wasteland
sections.body: Before the War of the Three Hammers, Searing Gorge was a green, rolling part of the Redridge chain. That land was lost over two hundred and thirty years ago. Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan summoned Ragnaros from deep beneath the world, hoping to turn defeat into victory. The Firelord tore the earth apart, raised Blackrock Mountain and reduced the great Dark Iron city of Thaurissan to smoking ruins. Ash, sulfur and volcanic glass covered the northern valley.

sections.title: The Cauldron and the Slag Pit
sections.body:
After their old capital fell, the Dark Iron dwarves seized the gorge for the materials their war machine needed. At the valley's heart, the Cauldron cuts deep into the stone as a vast open-pit excavation. In its lower reaches, the Slag Pit forms a harsh underground mining complex.

Dark Iron overseers and lumbering war golems force captured enemies into slave labor, hauling iron, mithril and rare Dark Iron ore from burning rock. Lava surges and roaming beasts threaten the miners at every turn.

sections.title: Thorium Brotherhood and Contested Paths
sections.body:
Thorium Point crowns the northern crags above the excavation. The Thorium Brotherhood holds this fortified outpost, after splitting from its kin in Blackrock Mountain. Its master craftsmen offer travelers neutral shelter in return for undermining Dark Iron operations or bringing rare smelting components.

Access to the gorge remains tightly controlled. The Alliance bars Stonewrought Pass toward Loch Modan with heavy iron gates, while Horde expeditions from nearby Kargath have cut a narrow trail through the eastern badlands to scout the region.

faq.q: Why is the Searing Gorge burned and covered in ash?
faq.answer: Over two hundred and thirty years ago, during the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan tried to summon a supernatural power to escape defeat. Instead, he brought forth Ragnaros the Firelord. The eruption shattered the southern Redridge range, raised Blackrock Mountain and burned the surrounding valleys into Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Who are the dwarves living at Thorium Point?
faq.answer: The dwarves at Thorium Point belong to the Thorium Brotherhood, an independent faction of Dark Iron dwarves who broke ties with their imperial kin beneath Blackrock Mountain. From their camp atop Thorium Point, they work as master smiths and artificers. They trade knowledge and crafting secrets with travelers who aid them against the Dark Iron forces below.

faq.q: What is going on in the Cauldron?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan controls the Cauldron, a vast open excavation that holds the underground Slag Pit. Overseers and war golems force captured prisoners into slave labor, mining precious ores, including Dark Iron, for the great forges inside Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: How do you get into Searing Gorge from Loch Modan?
aliases: how to open searing gorge door
faq.answer: Stonewrought Pass from Loch Modan is barred by a heavy locked gate guarded by Ironforge mountaineers. You can obtain the Key to Searing Gorge through an official task for Curator Thorius, ask a skilled rogue to pick the lock, or bypass the gate by taking the open trail south of Kargath in the Badlands.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Searing Gorge?
faq.answer: The Horde uses nearby Kargath in the Badlands as a base. Its commanders cut a mountain pass into the gorge to scout Dark Iron troop movements and secure routes toward Blackrock Mountain, a place of great strategic importance.

faq.q: Are there any dungeons or raid entrances inside Searing Gorge?
faq.answer: No instance portals open directly inside Searing Gorge, but its southern entrance leads into Blackrock Mountain. The mountain holds Blackrock Depths, Blackrock Spire and the deep passages to the Molten Core.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you can see Searing Gorge as a bitter reminder of the War of the Three Hammers and the Dark Iron clan's disastrous folly. Their excavations now threaten Khaz Modan's southern approaches.

As an Alliance traveler, you find Stonewrought Pass barred to keep the Dark Irons apart from peaceful dwarven settlements in Loch Modan. The Alliance sanctions courageous adventurers to strike into the gorge.
As a Horde traveler, you can use Kargath as a staging base. The Horde cut an overland route into the gorge to gather intelligence on Blackrock Mountain and disrupt Dark Iron operations in Khaz Modan.
As a miner, you can seek rich veins of mithril, truesilver and coveted Dark Iron ore in the volcanic wastes and the deep Slag Pit excavations.
As a rogue, your seasoned lockpicking can open the Stonewrought Pass gate between Loch Modan and the gorge.
